quiz.question: What does the principle of least privilege mean?
options: Everyone gets admin rights to avoid tickets
Users get only the access their job needs
quiz.answer_text: Users get only the access their job needs
quiz.why: Give the minimum access needed, for the time it's needed. It limits the damage if an account is compromised.
